title.en: Effective cutoffs and the Goldbach endpoint
title.zh: 显式截断与哥德巴赫终点

description.en: Make the arc-disjointness cutoff numerical, join consecutive finite certificates, and connect finite positivity to major- and minor-arc bounds at a common threshold.
description.zh: 给出保证弧不相交的数值阈值，拼接连续区间的有限证书，并在同一阈值处衔接有限范围的正性与主弧、次弧估计。
